name: Sobek
body:
Sobek is called the Raging God and the Father of Crocodiles. Like crocodiles, Sobek is known for his strength, ferocity, aggression, and speed.

Most of all, Sobek is recognized for his military prowess and his savage, primal nature.

Sobekian supplicant

Sobek appears as a crocodile-headed human male carrying a war scepter and an ankh. His crown is adorned with cobras wrapped around two ram horns, a small sun disc, and feathered plumes. Sailors, assassins, reptilians, loners, and evil soldiers pay homage to Sobek.

Primal

Granted Powers: Your magic grants you strength, speed, and ferocity which help you take what you want…when you want…however you want. Increase your base speed by 5 feet.

Sprint (Sp)

As a standard action, you can touch a creature to increase its base speed to 40 feet for 1 round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Frenzied Rage (Ex)

Starting at 8th level, as a swift action, you can enter a frenzied state. You gain a +2 sacred bonus to your Strength score, one extra attack per round, and a bonus on melee damage rolls equal to 1/2 your cleric level for 1 round. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + 1/2 your cleric level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Domain: 1st-wrath, 2nd-savage maw, 3rdblood scent, 4th-primal scream, 5th-moonstruck, 6th-bull’s strength, mass, 7th-monstrous physique lv, 8th-death clutch, 9th-massacre.
